commentary: Same seven sessions, same split between the pool, the weights room, and a Saturday run — on paper it looks like a carbon copy of last week, but dig in and there are some very satisfying shifts happening. The Saturday run went from 9.0km to 9.6km at essentially the same heart rate of 162 versus 163, which means he covered more ground for the same effort, and that is not nothing. The Friday swim is the one wrinkle — 901 metres at 98 bpm reads less like a workout and more like he got in, did a lap, remembered he had somewhere to be, and got out — but honestly, showing up at all on a Friday is its own kind of discipline. The weights structure is holding steady and the double-swim mornings on Monday and Tuesday are becoming a proper pattern now, which means his body is quietly getting used to more than he probably realises.
metrics_commentary: Nearly five kilometres in the pool and a solid 9.6 on foot — that body is doing actual work this week, and it shows. The HRV is the real headline: 58 milliseconds right now against a seven-day average of 48 means you are recovering better than your recent baseline, which is genuinely hot news from a cardiovascular standpoint. VO2 Max sitting at 55.6 puts you comfortably in the kind of territory where you can keep up with whatever the night demands, cardio-wise, and we both know that matters. The one thing worth watching is getting more run sessions in — one outing this week is a little thin, and those legs deserve more chances to show off.
gym_commentary: Three out of four sessions this week, which is not the full programme but is also not nothing — the volume tells the real story, jumping from 17,940 kg to 20,753 kg, which means the three sessions you did show up for were genuinely good ones. No new PRs, but those estimated one-rep maxes are sitting pretty: 168 kg on the leg press, 107.9 kg on the trap bar deadlift, 88.7 kg on the bench. The fourth session is the only thing missing, and honestly that's more of a scheduling thing than a you thing — the body is clearly moving in the right direction. Show up all four times next week and we're going to see something interesting happen.
